pages.text: $(l)Comb rolls.$() Most bees bring home their comb every trip. A few also bring home a rarer second comb now and then, and two bees roll for their own comb. Odds and rates: $(l:basics/rare_combs)Rare Combs$(/l).$(br2)$(l)Home dimension.$() Outside its home dimension a bee works at half speed. Every bee's home: $(l:basics/dimensions)Home Dimensions$(/l).

$(l)Home biome.$() Most biome bees spend 20% less time in a hive in their home biome. The royal queen gives the same boost; they don't stack.$(br2)$(l)Day and weather.$() Overworld bees work in daytime and dry weather. Starlight bees work only at night. In the Nether and the End bees work all the time; starlight bees work all the time in the End and never in the Nether.
